name: Movchannja
source:
Freedom is a spark – freedom to think, to act, to break free from pain or lies. Everyone seeks it, but be careful – wishes can come true, sometimes in ways you don’t expect.

[From [url=https://athymia-team.itch.io/movchannia]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
自由是火花——思考、行动、摆脱痛苦或谎言的自由。每个人都在寻求它，但要小心——愿望可能会实现，有时会以你意想不到的方式实现。

[来自[url=https://athymia-team.itch.io/movchannia]Itch.io[/url]]
